_description: Shrink-only baselines for the agent-guide gate (header of scripts/check-claude-md.mjs). `guides`: size budgets for AUTO-LOADED guides still over the 40,000-char cap — a listed guide may be at most its recorded size, and one not listed must be at most 40,000. `dangling`: per guide, backticked paths known to resolve to no tracked file and how many times each may occur — a miss past its count fails. `pnpm claude-md:update` lowers or removes entries (a shrunk guide, a fixed path) and never raises or adds one — an increase is a hand edit in a reviewable diff.
